authors: Elisabeth Schroeder, Klaus Thomauske, Jens Schmalzbauer, Sabrina Herberger, Christoph Gebert, Marina Velevska
title: Design and test of a new flow calorimeter for online detection of geothermal water heat capacity
experimental_method: Flow calorimeter: fluid at fixed T1 and P1 flows at known mass flux past an electrically heated nickel-chromium rod; cp = (heating power / mass flux)/(temperature rise corrected for heat exchange with the environment), Eq. 14.
uncertainties_stated: Mass-flux determination about 3 % error from degassing behind the pressure retention valve (balance method); errors versus reference cp below 1 % for water (about 1 % at worst for 143 C); NaCl errors vs. experimental references below 1 %.
quality_remarks: Instrument-development paper; test fluids water and NaCl solutions. Table 4 repeats the same measurements across reference blocks. Composition given as mNaCl/mwater without a definition. Year: Geothermics volume year 2015 (online 2014). Table 3 label cp_reference is NIST/Lemmon. No temperature scale stated.
